zh.title: 國防部偵獲8艘共艦7艘公務船與5架次共機侵擾北部東部空域
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲8艘共艦7艘公務船及5架次共機；3架次侵擾北部及東部空域。
body: 台灣國防部於8月18日上午發布最新共機艦動態。統計顯示，自8月17日上午6時起至8月18日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲8艘共艦、7艘公務船，以及5架次共機，持續在台灣周邊海空域活動。
國防部指出，在偵獲的5架次共機當中，有3架次共機侵擾台灣北部及東部空域。對此，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，實施嚴密監控與應處。
此外，根據本站統計紀錄，前一次於8月16日所記錄的動態資料為共機7架次、共艦8艘以及公務船2艘。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 8 PLA Vessels, 7 Official Ships, and 5 Aircraft Near Airspace
en.summary: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense detected eight PLA vessels, seven official ships, and five military aircraft.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 18 that it detected eight PLA naval vessels, seven official ships, and five military aircraft operating around the island between 06:00 on August 17 and 06:00 on August 18.

According to the defense ministry, three of the detected PLA aircraft entered Taiwan's northern and eastern airspace. Taiwan Armed Forces monitored the activity and responded using combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems.
Additionally, according to this site's recorded statistics, the previous tracking record on August 16 showed seven PLA aircraft, eight naval vessels, and two official ships in the area.
